summary: The one admitted E1804 Bazel source build completed successfully from the R1803-accepted three-source identity. The freshly emitted receipt binds 1,538 source inputs to sourceDigest f28be39fc1cd2acbd8e2433bb349b6086ead8f26b3a6f660049e0a69f18dcfee, verifies all 843 site files at siteDigest 9df3572f7ef26044872aa89612a5bfc3929902a03cb1671c428001e6b26464bd, and reports siteBuildId 3b0d0b8ca23975b945f9294432ee7fa0c6da893cbf636438e365a0bfe801c877. All 14 PxCube packages were rebuilt; the receipt reports no relocated historical output and exact crisp compiled equality. This is a local source build and verification only, not browser QA, a production deployment, or human release acceptance.

stderr.note: Contains the OpenJDK deprecation warning and Bazel progress/success output; process exit was 0.

build.receipt_and_log_copy: Exclusive byte-for-byte copies made after process exit; source mtimes were inside the captured run window. No site.evidence, PNG, or dist output copied.

targeted_hh_controller_community_tests.overlap: These same test files are included in the 288-test npm suite; do not add this count to the distinct total.

tests.distinct_count_note: 2 build-helper tests + 288 npm-suite tests + 1 separately invoked Atlas built-import test; the 133 targeted HH tests are overlapping coverage, excluded from the sum.

limits: The build compiles and verifies a fresh local source site; it does not run the Pages deployment job or deploy production.
No browser QA, mounted DOM, production service, real account, external email, or human release acceptance is claimed.
No source files, Git state, packages, or deployment state were changed by this task beyond normal generated local Bazel output and the two copied build evidence files.

The shell/bazel environment is the canonical configured build environment; the build documentation notes Linux shared libraries are a host requirement rather than claiming a fully hermetic OS toolchain.
